name: Utility Billing Summary
query: select mr.name as "Meter Reading:Link/Meter Reading:180", mr.property as "Utility Property:Link/Utility property:180", mr.meter_serial_no as "Meter Serial No:Data:160", mr.reading_date as "Reading Date:Date:120", mr.consumption as "Consumption:Float:120", mr.total_amount as "Total Amount:Currency:140", mr.status as "Status:Data:100" from `tabMeter Reading` mr order by mr.reading_date desc, mr.modified desc
